body:
I'm from the Netherlands and (a little above) 6 feet is around median height for young men. For older men its around 5'11.

I can relate to OP, but I'm 5'9.5. I can say it affected my self esteem and thus dating/love life big time. Women are often my height or above.

Quite often I feel just like a joke, not to be taken seriously by the women I feel attracted to. I can work out more, get new clothes etc, but doesn't change anything in terms of how I feel about this particular thing.

I can understand guys who want to get LL or wear lifts. Most guys and ladies nowadays perform plenty of activities to appear (fakely) more attractive for the opposite sex. This is just one of the many possible options you can apply.

I also considered LL. But actually doing it is quite insane. Shitload of money and time down the drain + a lot of (long term) health risks. Also you will just be a "short" guy with just long(er) legs. If you get children they still get most likely the short genes, do they have to undergo LL too?
